notes.title: Join Us at Steam Next Fest: Play Architecture Designer & More!
notes.content:
We’re joining Steam Next Fest: June 2025!

Alongside our partners, we’re bringing a variety of exciting games, and one of them is Architecture Designer – a creative journey where you restore, renovate, and design stunning interiors!

What is Architecture Designer?

Step into the world of interior transformation and turn abandoned, dusty spaces into breathtaking masterpieces! Clean, repair, furnish, and decorate to create cozy, stylish, and luxurious designs. Whether you prefer a modern aesthetic or a classic touch, the choices are yours!

Why should you check it out at Steam Next Fest?
○ Play the Architecture Designer demo for free!
○ Discover a lineup of exciting games from us and our partners.
○ Share your feedback and help shape the game’s future!

We’re excited to bring Architecture Designer to Steam Next Fest and can’t wait to hear your thoughts! Your feedback is key to making this the ultimate home design experience.
Save the date – Steam Next Fest: June 2025! Get ready to build, design, and create your dream interiors!

Wishlist now and be the first to try it!
